'''House Kuhlvult''' was one of the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] noble families. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], House Kuhlvult engaged in a conspiracy to wrest control of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] from [[House Kuat]]. [[Kateel of Kuhlvult]] belonged to House Kuhlvult.
